::: {#sol-rely-on-units}

Switch off a random set of [unit](feedforward-networks.qmd#def-unit)s at each [training step](pytorch-basics.qmd#def-training-step).
A [unit](feedforward-networks.qmd#def-unit) that may be missing at any step cannot carry a prediction on its own,
so each prediction has to rest on many [unit](feedforward-networks.qmd#def-unit)s
[@srivastava2014dropout].

:::
